visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with messy dark hair and black glasses is shown in a close-up, speaking with animated facial expressions in a room with light-colored wooden shelves and green walls. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit Taipei MRT station platform where a yellow promotional stand titled "CPR Challenge" is set up, surrounded by crowds of commuters. (3) Several individuals are shown kneeling on the station floor, performing rhythmic chest compressions on beige mannequins; a woman in a white shirt and a man in a blue shirt are seen guiding participants while a tablet screen displays real-time feedback. (4) The man from the first scene, now wearing a black and white patterned shirt, participates in the challenge; he is shown receiving a yellow box and then performing CPR on a mannequin while focused on the tablet interface. (5) A different man in a white T-shirt holding a heart diagram explains the medical procedure using a printed board, then demonstrates applying sticky AED pads to the mannequin's chest. (6) The first man is shown operating a small gray electronic device (AED trainer) with colorful buttons, following instructions and looking at the mannequin. (7) A montage shows various participants including children and students kneeling and practicing compressions. (8) The first man returns in a close-up, speaking directly to the camera with a smiling expression. (9) A final graphic appears showing a website and social media logos.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator, several event staff, and a crowd of over 20 commuters and participants.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian man with messy curly hair, wearing thick black-framed glasses and a black and white patterned button-down shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a warm indoor room with wooden furniture and a green accent wall. Most of the video takes place in a modern, clean, and brightly lit Taipei MRT station with yellow event banners and moving commuters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice starts narrating with high arousal and a bright, energetic tone. An upbeat electronic pop track with a strong, driving four-on-the-floor beat (approx. 125 BPM) begins immediately. (2) A "whoosh" sound effect accompanies a fast visual transition. The speaker's pitch variability is high as he emphasizes statistics about heart failure. (3) As the scene moves to the station, a subtle digital "ding" SFX is heard as reward text appears. Faint ambient room tone from the station is heard but kept very low in the mix. (4) A second male voice, deeper and more instructional, enters to explain AED usage; he speaks with clear articulation and lower pitch. Rhythmic electronic beeps from the AED device pulse in time with the music. (5) A synthesized female voice from the AED machine emits a clear command: "貼在病人胸部..." followed by a sharp mechanical click SFX as a pad is placed. (6) The primary male narrator returns with a high-valence, positive tone, encouraging viewers to learn CPR. The music maintains its energetic intensity until a final fading reverb tail at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Context -> Experience -> Instruction -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'CPR Challenge' event held at Taipei MRT stations by the 'Anne' team. It uses a high-energy vlog format to highlight the low survival rate of cardiac arrest and encourages public participation in learning CPR and AED usage through first-hand experience and reward-based incentives.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator is directly participating in and promoting the 'Anne' team's event, showing brand logos and providing a call to action for their website and YouTube.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a fast-paced, social-media-native editing style with frequent text overlays and high audio event density to maintain viewer engagement while delivering medical educational content.
